t: The LAP 20A 2G light switch with classic raised rounded profile in satin brass complements modern and traditional interiors. Controls 2 x separate mains voltage lighting circuits from multiple locations. Ideal for hallways and open-plan living areas, this durable rocker switch combines practical functionality with a premium decorative finish. For straightforward installation, the unit includes captive terminal screws that prevent loss during wiring and fits into a standard 25mm back box.
